{{SameName|Frost Mystery|[[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Invasion]] • [[Frost Mystery|Modern]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date=4th of December 2021|event=[[Frost Invasion Event]]}} {{for|other [[Mystery (Disambiguation)|Mystery]] enemies|other uses of [[Frost_(Disambiguation)|Frost]]}} {{ZombieSandbox |title1 = Frost Mystery |image-static = FrostMystery.png |image-dynamic = FrostMysteryLegacyDynamic.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |first_wave_appearance = 8 (Originally) |tab_1 = Event |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |sandbox_base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |sandbox_speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |sandbox_hidden = No |sandbox_fly = No |sandbox_ghost = No |sandbox_lead = No |sandbox_immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Frozen Spawn}}''' - On death, turns into spawns into a random enemy depending on the wave. }} ==Description== The '''Frost Mystery''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though it will copy the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] [[Frost Mystery]] statistics. Compared to the [[Snowy (Frost Invasion)|Snowy]], the '''Frost Mystery''' had higher health and faster speed. Upon its death, the '''Frost Mystery''' spawned a random enemy from a set list. The enemy spawned depended on the wave, though this no longer happens in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Appearance== The '''Frost Mystery''' has blue translucent skin. It is faceless. The '''Frost Mystery''' has a small neon blue humanoid inside its torso, likely representing the enemy it spawns upon its death. ==Enemy Spawned== The '''Frost Mystery''' is able to spawn more enemies after its debut. ''Italic'' names can be spawned from the '''Frost Mystery's''' debut. In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no enemies spawn. *''[[Snowy (Frost Invasion)|Snowy]]'' *''[[Frozen (Frost Invasion)|Frozen]]'' *''[[Cold Mist (Frost Invasion)|Cold Mist]]'' *[[Packed Ice (Frost Invasion)|Packed Ice]] (from wave 11) *[[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minion]] (from wave 11) *[[Unstable Ice (Frost Invasion)|Unstable Ice]] (from wave 13) *[[Crying Angel (Frost Invasion)|Crying Angel]] (from wave 19) ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *As '''Frost Mysteries''' and their spawns come in hordes, towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies like the [[Pursuit]], [[Pyromancer]], [[Gladiator]] and [[Demoman]] are effective. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]] are recommended for later waves, boosted by the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]]. *Certain spawned enemies require specific towers to be reliably kept under control. **[[Cold Mist (Frost Invasion)|Cold Mist]]s can slip past if hidden defense is short. Multiple Level 2+ [[Minigunner]]s ensure safety against them. **[[Ranger]]s are your best bet against [[Crying Angel (Frost Invasion)|Crying Angel]]s, especially if they spawn in huge numbers from '''Frost Mysteries'''. **Watch out for the [[Unstable Ice (Frost Invasion)|Unstable Ice]]. If too many spawn, they can stun many towers. Exercise caution and place your towers away from the path. The [[Pyromancer]] is also recommended to reduce its stun radius, making it stun less towers. *The [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage against the '''Frost Mystery''' and its spawns. It is also a multi-hit tower, so it is quite effective. **It can reduce the stun radius of the [[Unstable Ice (Frost Invasion)|Unstable Ice]] by 33%. *If a '''Frost Mystery''' is near the end of the map, try not to kill it, as it may spawn a high health enemy like the [[Packed Ice (Frost Invasion)|Packed Ice]], reducing your base health more than if it wasn't killed. *Slowing towers, while generally not needed, can still be useful. The [[Toxic Gunner]] is notable for its permanent 50% slowdown while still doing fairly decent DPS. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFrostMystery.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} WinterThumbnail.png|'''Frost Mystery''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} CodePI1.jpg|'''Frost Mystery''' on a promotional image. 1BillionCode.jpg|'''Frost Mystery''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Frost Mystery''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionFrostMysteryIconIG.png|'''Frost Mystery''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Mystery''' was similar to the [[Mystery|Mysteries]] and [[Mystery Boss]]es that appear in every gamemode. *Summoned enemies from the '''Frost Mystery''' were called "''Mystery's ______''" instead of "''Frost Mystery's'' ______". ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3]] **'''Frost Mystery''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Frost Mystery''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Frost Mystery''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Frost Mystery]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. **{{Bug}} No longer summons anything on death. {{FrostInvasion|[[Packed Ice (Frost Invasion)|Packed Ice]]|Wave 7|Frost Mystery|Wave 8|[[Snow Golem (Frost Invasion)|Snow Golem]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Frost Mystery}}
